许都屯田，为日后南征积谷

en.decision_text: Cao Cao consolidates power in Ye after pacifying Hebei. Yuan Xi and Yuan Shang have fled to Liaodong — Gongsun Kang has not yet declared allegiance. The north is not fully secured; a southern campaign now would be strategically reckless. Xiahou Dun is ordered to Xuchang with 30,000 troops to drill the central army. Agents are dispatched south to probe Liu Biao's illness and Jingzhou's defenses. Agricultural colonies are expanded at Xuchang and Ye to stockpile grain — the campaign can wait; supplies cannot.

Expand military farms at Xuchang for future southern campaign

en.decision_text: Liu Bei at Xinye knows his forces are too weak. Hearing of the genius Zhuge Liang, he personally visits his thatched cottage three times to win his service. Guan Yu and Zhang Fei drill the troops while Zhao Yun patrols the borders. Sun Qian is sent to Xiangyang to strengthen ties with Liu Biao.

Develop agriculture to support the people
Strengthen ties with Liu Biao for mutual defense

zh.decision_text: 【蓄势江东】孙权继承父兄基业，坐领江东。黄祖据江夏，乃杀父仇人，不可不除。然此时曹操在北虎视眈眈，江东不可二面树敌。命周瑜为大都督，在柴桑整训水师。鲁肃巡江防务，张昭坐镇建业稳固后方。先练水军，待时机成熟再图江夏。

en.decision_text: Sun Quan rules Jiangdong. Huang Zu at Jiangxia killed his father — this blood debt must be repaid. But Cao Cao's shadow looms in the north; Jiangdong cannot afford enemies on two fronts. Zhou Yu drills the navy at Chaisang. Lu Su inspects the river defenses while Zhang Zhao secures the home front at Jianye. First, train the fleet — Jiangxia can wait for the right moment.

Send envoys to Xinye, befriend Liu Bei against Cao Cao
